label: WhatsApp after-hours auto reply
info: Tells people on WhatsApp that you are closed when they write outside your opening hours, once every 12 hours per person.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scopes events:read and messages:send.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** Open the function node to set your days and hours (and write the same days and hours in the text of the reply) (they use the time zone of the computer that runs Node-RED) and the pause between two replies to the same person. Group messages are skipped. The first check after you deploy only remembers the newest message, so write to your number from another phone after the deploy and wait up to 30 seconds for the answer. Answers leave one every 10 seconds and never more than 60 an hour in all, so a busy day cannot use up your message allowance.
